tagline: Short ads, cut to stop the thumb
intro: We are a small edit-first ad studio. We write, shoot and cut short-form video ads for consumer brands, then plan and run them on social and search, and recut them every week from what the numbers say.
audience: Consumer brands in Australia and New Zealand selling online, from a first test budget to a full always-on program, mostly in beauty, food and drink, fitness and pets.
pricing_note: A monthly fee covering a set number of new edits, plus campaign planning, buying and reporting. Shoot days are quoted separately. Ad spend is paid to the platforms by you.

services.title: Short-form video ads
services.description: Scripted, shot and cut in vertical first, with a hook in the opening second, captions burned in and versions for every placement.

services.title: Creator edits
services.description: Footage from creators and customers recut into ads that keep their voice and add a clear offer and call to action.

services.title: Planning and buying
services.description: Campaigns set up across paid social and search, with budgets and audiences planned around which edits we want to learn from.

services.title: Weekly recuts
services.description: Every week we look at where people stop watching, then recut the hook, the order or the ending of the edits that are nearly working.

process.title: Script the hooks
process.description: A call about your product and customers, then ten hooks and three scripts for you to pick from before anything is shot.

process.title: Shoot and cut
process.description: A half-day shoot or your existing footage, cut into a first round of edits with captions and sizes for every placement.

process.title: Run and recut
process.description: The edits go live, we watch the drop-off every week and recut what is close, so the ads keep getting better.

proof.text: The recuts are the point. Week four's version of an ad looks nothing like week one's, and it is better.
They showed us exactly where people stopped watching and what they changed because of it.
Fast turnaround, clear captions, no fuss.
